name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Schwoicher Bauer
beschreibung: The Schwoicher Bauer farm holiday apartment is located in Kufstein and offers comfortable apartments with Alpine views. The agricultural farm provides insights into dairy farming. In the region, the Kufsteiner Festung and the historic old town invite visitors to sightsee. Hikes in the Kaisergebirge are possible from the accommodation. Guests benefit from the good connection to public transport for excursions. Catering with farm products such as milk and eggs is offered.
